info.title: NW-ITSM API
info.description: API v2 of NW-ITSM, served by the Rust backend next to the legacy PHP application.

get.summary:
Places of a server room no rack outside the trash takes, like the
classic form offers them (`ajax/dcroom_size.php`).

parameters.name: current
parameters.description: Position of the rack being edited: offered although it is taken.

403.description: No create or update right on the racks

get.summary: Lists the versions of a software visible to the session, by name.

403.description: No read right on the software

post.summary:
Adds a version to a software, in its entity and with its sharing. The
software notes it in its history.

403.description: No update right on the software, or entity not selected

delete.summary:
Deletes a version for good, with its installations (without history).
Licenses bought or used with it leave it to the classic interface.

403.description: No update right on the software, or entity not selected

404.description: Unknown or not visible software or version

409.description: Must be done in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

patch.summary: Changes a version: its history, and that of its software.

403.description: No update right on the software, or entity not selected

404.description: Unknown or not visible software or version

get.summary: Lists the assets of a type visible to the session (templates excluded).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description:
Text searched in the name, serial number, inventory number (and UUID
of computers).

parameters.name: trash
parameters.description: List the items in the trash instead of the others.

parameters.name: software_id
parameters.description: Licenses only: those of this software.

403.description: No read right on this type

post.summary: Creates an asset in one of the selected entities.

403.description: No create right, or entity not selected

409.description: Another item has the same values (`duplicate`), or must be created in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

get.summary:
Values of a form field for an asset of the entity: the entity's own
values and the recursive ones of its parents, like the legacy dropdowns.

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: Entity of the asset being edited: one of the selected entities.

parameters.name: software_id
parameters.description: The software whose licenses or versions are offered (licenses).

parameters.name: exclude_id
parameters.description: A license not offered as parent: the one being edited.

400.description: Invalid parameters, or no such field for this type

403.description: No create or update right, or entity not selected

get.summary:
Values the form of a new item of the type starts with, as the classic
form (`getEmpty`) shows them.

403.description: No create or update right on this type

get.summary:
Lists the templates of a type visible to the session, by name
(`CommonDBTM::listTemplates`).

403.description: No read nor create right on this type

post.summary:
Creates a template in one of the selected entities. Its fields are not
checked for unicity, and its status fills no date.

403.description: No create right, or entity not selected

409.description: Must be created in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

get.summary: Returns a template visible to the session.

403.description: No read right on this type

delete.summary:
Deletes a template for good, with its history and the rows the PHP
code deletes with it (contracts, documents, infocom...). Linked data
whose purge is not ported leaves it to the classic interface.

403.description: No purge right (on the type, or on its infocom), or entity not selected

409.description: Must be done in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

patch.summary:
Updates a template of a selected entity. Its fields are not checked
for unicity.

403.description: No update right, or entity not selected

409.description: Items of other entities use the shared template (`sharing_in_use`), or must be changed in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

post.summary:
Creates an item from a template, in the entity of the template (one of
the selected entities). The fields not given take the values of the
template; its other columns are copied, and its infocom, contracts and
documents cloned for the item. Other linked data (components, network
ports, software...) leaves it to the classic interface.

403.description: No create right, or entity of the template not selected

409.description: Another item has the same values (`duplicate`), or must be created in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

get.summary: Returns an asset visible to the session, including one in the trash.

403.description: No read right on this type

delete.summary:
Deletes an asset of the trash for good, with its history and the rows
the PHP code deletes with it (contracts, documents, connections,
infocom...). Linked data whose purge is not ported (network ports,
components, software, tickets...) leaves it to the classic interface.

403.description: No purge right (on the type, or on its infocom), or entity not selected

409.description: Not in the trash (`not_in_trash`), or must be done in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

patch.summary:
Updates an asset of a selected entity. For computers, the changes of
contact, user, group, location (and status, depending on the settings)
are copied to the connected items and components, like the PHP code.

403.description: No update right, or entity not selected

409.description: Another item has the same values (`duplicate`), items of other entities use the shared item (`sharing_in_use`), or must be changed in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

post.summary: Restores an asset from the trash.

403.description: No delete right, or entity not selected

409.description: Must be done in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

get.summary: Lists the software installed on an asset.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Type of asset: computers, monitors, network-equipments, peripherals, phones or printers

403.description: No read right on the software or on the asset

post.summary:
Installs a version of a software on an asset, like the form of its
software tab: in the entity of the asset (the active entity of the
session for a phone), noted in the history of both.

400.description: Invalid fields, unknown version, or no software for this type

403.description: Neither the asset nor the software can be changed, or their entities do not match

delete.summary:
Uninstalls a software from an asset, for good, like the "Delete
permanently" action of its software tab (no event), noted in the
history of the asset and of the version.

403.description: Neither the asset nor the software can be changed

404.description: Unknown or not visible asset or installation

post.summary: Moves an asset to the trash.

403.description: No delete right, or entity not selected

409.description: Must be done in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

get.summary:
Opens a session from the PHP application (`front/nw_bridge.php`) and
redirects to the application. On failure, redirects to the login page.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token signed by the PHP application.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Page of the application to open (`/app/...`).

303.description: Redirection to the application or to the login page

post.summary: Issues a token opening the classic interface as the current user.

200.description: Token for the PHP application, nonce cookie set

403.description: Password expired since the login

post.summary: Logs in with a local ITSM-NG account and sets the session cookie.
post.description:
After 5 failures for a login from an address, or 20 from an address,
attempts are refused for 15 minutes.

403.description: Account disabled, password expired or no usable profile

post.summary:
Changes the password of the current user. The other sessions of the user
end; this one gets a new cookie.

200.description: Password changed, new session cookie set

400.description: Wrong current password, same or weak new password

403.description: External account or no `password_update` right

post.summary: Replaces an expired password and logs in (legacy `updatepassword.php`).

400.description: Password not expired, same or weak new password

403.description: Account disabled or locked

get.summary: Lists the entities the active profile can select.

put.summary: Selects the entities to work on (legacy entity selector).

200.description: Entities changed, new session cookie set

403.description: Entity not allowed for the profile

put.summary:
Activates another profile of the user, with its default entities (like
the legacy profile selector).

200.description: Profile changed, new session cookie set

403.description: Profile not granted or not usable

patch.summary:
Updates the preferences of the current user, with an entry in the
user's history.

entity_id.description: Entity of the new asset: one of the selected entities.

AssetDefaults.description: Values of a new item set by the settings; `null` for the other types.

is_helpdesk_visible.description:
Software: can be chosen in a ticket
(`default_software_helpdesk_visible`).

allOf.description: Connectors and features of the type, `null` for the other types.
Fields of the datacenter items, `null` for the other types.
Fields of the software, `null` for the other types.
Fields of the licenses, `null` for the other types.

duplicates.description:
After a write: items with the same values as this one, reported by
a unicity criterion that does not refuse them.

is_global.description: Used by several computers at once.

is_template.description: A template: a model of the items of its type.

memory.description: Printers (free text) and network equipment (MiB) only.

oneOf.description: Computers, printers and network equipment only.

page_counter.description: Printers only: current counter of pages.

size.description: Monitors only: diagonal in inches, as stored (`"21.50"`).

oneOf.description: Computers only: how the computer is updated (inventory tool...).

is_global.description:
Monitors, printers, peripherals and phones only: one item for
several computers.

is_recursive.description: Visible in sub-entities. Can be set, not unset (classic interface).

memory.description:
Printers: free text. Network equipment: a whole number of MiB, or
empty.

network_id.description: Computers, printers and network equipment only.

size.description: Monitors only: decimal number of inches (`"21.5"`, `"21,5"`).

AssetFields.description:
Fields of a creation or an update. Absent fields are left unchanged;
`null` clears a field (empty text, no related object).

total.description: Number of matching assets on every page.

AssetPermissions.description: What the session may do with an asset.

purge.description: Delete for good, from the trash.

trash.description: Move to the trash and restore.

AssetType.description: Type of asset, in the paths.

token.description:
To pass to `front/nw_bridge.php?token=...` within one minute, from
the same browser (a nonce cookie is set).

ChoiceField.description: A field of the asset forms offering a list of values.

items.description: At most 50 values, sorted by label.

position.description:
Racks: place in the room, `"<column>,<row>"` (`"0"` or empty for
none).

room_orientation.description:
Racks: door orientation in the room, 1 north, 2 east, 3 south, 4 west
(0: never set).

DatacenterFields.description: Fields of the datacenter items in a creation or an update.

position.description:
Racks: place in the room, `"<column>,<row>"` as offered by
`/assets/racks/positions`, `"0"` for none.

room_orientation.description: Racks: door orientation, 1 north, 2 east, 3 south, 4 west.

width.description: Racks; `null` empties it (stored as 0, like the classic form).

DuplicateNotice.description: Items with the same values, reported but not refused.

entity_id.description: Entity to select; `null` selects every entity of the profile.

details.description:
More codes, for example the broken rules of `weak_password`
(`too_short`, `missing_digit`, `missing_lowercase`,
`missing_uppercase`, `missing_symbol`) or the reason of
`legacy_required` (`business_rules`, `field_unicity`,
`linked_items`, `notifications`, `plugins`), or the fields of a
`duplicate`.

Features.description: Connectors and features of monitors, printers and phones (`have_*`).

Installation.description: A software installed on the asset.

installed_on.description: Date of installation, given by the inventory.

valid_licenses.description: The licenses of the software are valid.

InstallationList.description: The software installed on an asset.

can_edit.description:
The software tab offers to install and uninstall: a right on the
software, the asset in one of the selected entities. Each version
is still checked.

items.description:
Outside the trash, of the software visible to the session, by
software and version.

LicenseDetail.description: Fields of the licenses of a software.

allow_overquota.description: More affectations than its number are allowed.

number.description:
Number of affectations it covers (`0` or more; the classic form
calls 0 unlimited, but its validity counts it as 0).

LicenseFields.description: Fields of the licenses in a creation or an update.

parent_license_id.description: A license of the same software, not under this one.

software_id.description: Its software, chosen at its creation (required then).

language.description:
Language code (`fr_FR`...), `null` for the default language. Absent:
unchanged.

Ref.description: A related object: id and display name.

name.description: `null` when the related row no longer exists.

RoomPosition.description: A free place of the room.

level.description: Depth in the tree, 1 for the root.

recursive_allowed.description: It can be selected with its sub-entities.

bridge.description: The classic interface can be opened without logging in again.

change_password.description: The user can change their password here (local account and right).

recursive.description: The selected entity includes its sub-entities.

oneOf.description: Selected entity; `null` when every entity of the profile is selected.

profiles.description: Every profile granted to the user.

rights.description: Rights of the active profile, as legacy bitmasks per module.

language.description: Language in use (`fr_FR`...): the user's choice or the default one.

language_is_default.description: The language is the default one of the application.

is_helpdesk_visible.description: Can be chosen in a ticket.

valid_licenses.description: None of its licenses is invalid (computed from the licenses).

SoftwareFields.description: Fields of the software in a creation or an update.

is_update.description: Not an upgrade: the software it upgrades is cleared.

upgrade_from_id.description: Software it is an upgrade of, kept only with `is_update`.

allOf.description: The fields given to the items created from the template.

entity_id.description: Entity of the new template: one of the selected entities.

TemplateFields.description:
Fields of a template. Absent fields are left unchanged; `null` clears a
field.

TemplateList.description: The templates of a type visible to the session.

can_create.description: The session may create templates, and items from them.

name.description: Name given to the items created from it.

installations.description: Items it is installed on, outside the trash.

is_recursive.description: Follows the sharing of its software.

VersionFields.description:
Fields of a version. Absent fields are left unchanged (empty for a new
version); `null` clears a field.

state_id.description: A status offered for the versions (`is_visible_softwareversion`).

can_edit.description:
The session may add, change and purge them (update right on the
software, in one of its entities).

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Login, logout and the bridge with the classic interface

tags.name: session
tags.description: Current session: profile, entities, password, preferences
